source: addresses.parquet joined many-to-one on address_id; no target or post-period fields
settings: reuse frozen S6 alpha=1, Tweedie power=1.5, log link, max_iter=100, training-only preprocessing and sqrt(exposure) rate weighting
selection_rule: compare within the same line, fold and target; consider F2023 first and use F2024 only as a frozen challenge, never as a 2025 score
limitations: One supplied address snapshot has no historical address-version timestamps.
Both fold financial targets use end-2024 claim valuations; neither is realised ultimate.
The conditional target depends on unverified financial and monetary IBNR assumptions.
2025 outcomes are unavailable, so 2025 D2 cannot be measured.
